title: Period, Symmetry, and Graph of s = cot(2t)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Graph the function s = \cot 2t in the ts-plane (with t horizontal and s vertical). State the fundamental period of the function and identify the symmetry of its graph.

steps.title: Determine the Fundamental Period
steps.explanation: Because the base cotangent function cot(t) has period pi, replacing t with 2t compresses the graph horizontally by a factor of 2, giving period pi/2.
steps.why: cot(2(t + pi/2)) = cot(2t + pi) = cot(2t) for all t in the domain.

steps.title: Locate Vertical Asymptotes and Zeros
steps.explanation: Since cot(2t) = cos(2t)/sin(2t), vertical asymptotes occur where sin(2t) = 0 (t = k*pi/2), and t-intercepts occur where cos(2t) = 0 (t = pi/4 + k*pi/2).
steps.why: Rational trigonometric ratios have vertical asymptotes at the zeros of their denominators.

steps.title: Test for Algebraic Symmetry
steps.explanation: Replacing t with -t negates the output value, proving that s = cot(2t) is an odd function whose graph is symmetric about the origin.
steps.why: A function satisfying f(-t) = -f(t) is odd and exhibits rotational symmetry of 180 degrees about the origin.
